name: page-builder
description: A production line for website pages of a B2B service business: service, industry, case study, blog and landing pages. Runs an architecture gate before writing, then structure, copy, a humanisation pass, search and AI visibility, UI/UX, conversion and technical passes, and a technical gate before publish. A blind judge scores the page (threshold 85). Ships four Page Kits, a registry of ~25 page types by funnel stage, and the gate and scorecard definitions.
